# What does this PR do?

Update MFSDP v2 owner planning:
- (from https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7977) [Minor linting fix](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7974/files#diff-2a96e7fd25fb70d844f02d9e5e26f7adb45f125b1f363f6182f904ae71a5922dL144-R147)
- (from https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7977) Reword from "plan" to "layout" (missed some cases previously)
- **Assign owner work across multiple groups at once to properly balance a full model.** Important for follow-up work and the biggest scope in here.

Will use this for https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7519.

nodes.body:
Because it's a list after all. I guess it's decided by something like

```
order = []
for each parameter in the optimizer:
  parameter_group = get_containing_parameter_group(parameter)
  if parameter_group is not already in order:
    order.push_back(parameter_group)
```

I'm not saying that's a problem -- we just need to make sure the readers and writers of the list assume the same order.

# What does this PR do?

Update MFSDP v2 owner planning:
- (from https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7977) [Minor linting fix](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7974/files#diff-2a96e7fd25fb70d844f02d9e5e26f7adb45f125b1f363f6182f904ae71a5922dL144-R147)
- (from https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7977) Reword from "plan" to "layout" (missed some cases previously)
- **Assign owner work across multiple groups at once to properly balance a full model.** Important for follow-up work and the biggest scope in here.

Will use this for https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7519.
